name: USD/CHF Triple SMA Crossover - 3 Lot Sizing
description: Multi-timeframe moving average crossover strategy on USD/CHF using 20/50/200-day SMAs on 1H timeframe. Long when 20 crosses above 50 or 200, short when crossing below. Position sizing: 3 standard lots (300,000 units) for 20×50 crosses, 6 standard lots (600,000 units) for 20×200 crosses.
source:
# USD/CHF Triple SMA Crossover Strategy
# Long when 20-day SMA crosses above 50-day or 200-day SMA
# Short when 20-day SMA crosses below 50-day or 200-day SMA
# Position sizing: 300,000 units for 20×50, 600,000 units for 20×200

# Data source - 1H timeframe
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Calculate SMAs (converting days to hourly periods: 24 hours per day)
sma_20 = ma(period=480, type=MAType.sma)(close)    # 20-day = 480 hours
sma_50 = ma(period=1200, type=MAType.sma)(close)   # 50-day = 1200 hours
sma_200 = ma(period=4800, type=MAType.sma)(close)  # 200-day = 4800 hours

# Crossover signals for 20×50
cross_up_50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
cross_down_50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Crossover signals for 20×200
cross_up_200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
cross_down_200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Combined long/short entry signals
long_signal = cross_up_50 or cross_up_200
short_signal = cross_down_50 or cross_down_200

# Entry/exit zones - each crossover closes current and opens new position
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_signal, short_entry=short_signal)

# Position sizing based on which crossover triggered
# 600,000 units (6 lots) for 20×200 crossovers, 300,000 units (3 lots) for 20×50 crossovers
is_200_cross = cross_up_200 or cross_down_200
is_50_cross = cross_up_50 or cross_down_50

trade_size = 600000 if is_200_cross else (300000 if is_50_cross else 0)

# Position sizing with unit type (fixed lot sizing)
position_size(type="unit")(size=trade_size)

# Visualize SMAs
timeseries_lines(
    title="Triple SMA Crossover",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day SMA", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="50-Day SMA", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="200-Day SMA", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200)
